lines.sub: Paani. Sirf saada paani. Aur is company ki value 1 arab dollar se zyada.
Ye kahani hai Liquid Death ki.
Mike Cessario ad banate the. Music festivals mein unhone kuch ajeeb dekha.
Kalakaar energy drink ke can mein paani peete the. Bas cool dikhne ke liye.
Idea: paani ko beer jaise lambe can mein bharo. Aur brand banao kisi punk band jaisa.
Naam: Liquid Death. Naara: Murder Your Thirst.
Investors hanse. To Mike ne product se pehle hi ek ad bana diya.
Sasta sa video, aur laakhon views. Log poochne lage: ye milega kahan?
Phir ajeeb stunts. Hate comments se poore gaane tak bana diye.
Aaj is paani ki company ki value 1 arab dollar se upar hai.
Sabak: boring category mein sabse zyada personality wala brand jeetta hai.
Aisi aur kahaniyon ke liye, follow karo!
